commentary.text: 90+12' That's it for today, Jose Luis Munuera Montero has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+11' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the roof of the net and forces a good save out of Jan Oblak.
90+11' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
90+10' Luis Milla (Getafe) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

90+10' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Jan Oblak has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The ball goes out of play. Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
90+9' The current number of corner kicks is 1:11.
90+9' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
90+8' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
90+8' Jordi (Getafe) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
90+8' Getafe take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+8' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
90+7' Damian Suarez (Getafe) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
90+6' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90+6' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Getafe.
90+4' Patricio Moreno Ruiz has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) replacing Diego Rico.
90+4' Substitution. Gaston Alvarez makes way for Omar Alderete (Getafe).
90+3' 3 - 3 Goal! Borja Mayoral (Getafe) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jan Oblak into the bottom left corner.
90+3' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+3' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
90+1' Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
90+1' That looked a certain handball by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
90+1' Damian Suarez (Getafe) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Good work from Getafe as they win a corner.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
90' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
87' 3 - 2 Goal! Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Jan Oblak. He makes it 3:2.
86' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
84' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jan Oblak intercepts the ball.
82' Jose Luis Munuera Montero shows a yellow card to Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
82' Substitution. Nemanja Maksimovic is replaced by Jordi (Getafe).
81' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Marcos Llorente and he is replaced by Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).
81' Substitution. Samuel Lino did his best and is replaced by Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid).
81' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

80' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Jan Oblak, who pulls off a stunning save! Getafe have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
79' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
78' Jan Oblak pulls off a great save to deny Juanmi Latasa (Getafe), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
76' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z.
76' Getafe hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
73' The attendance is 46401.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) comes onto the pitch so that Jaime Mata can be given a rest.

72' Nice move, nice attempt! Luis Milla (Getafe) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
69' 3 - 1 Goal! David Soria gets a hand on the penalty from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid), but can't stop it from flying inside the right post.
68' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
68' Damian Suarez (Getafe) is booked.
68' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
67' Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
67' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
65' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.

63' 2 - 1 Goal! Marcos Llorente hands Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header low into the middle of the goal. 2:1.

62' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Jan Oblak was alert and the score remains the same.
62' Getafe work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
62' Luis Milla (Getafe) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Getafe win a corner.
62' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

61' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
60' Flag up against Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rodrigo de Paul departs the field of play to be replaced by Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid).
55' That was close! Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar.
53' 1 - 1 Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is first to latch onto the rebound near the penalty spot, and he produces a fantastic header which goes inside the left post.
53' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is flagged for offside.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luis Milla (Getafe) was quite harsh and Jose Luis Munuera Montero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' Here's the latest number of offsides – 8:0.
50' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged offside.
48' Jaime Mata swings the cross over. Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the right post.
47' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Luis Milla (Getafe).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) is replaced by Damian Suarez.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Getafe are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' 1 - 0 Rodrigo Riquelme sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the top left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
42' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.
41' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
40' Getafe quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

40' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Getafe are going to take it.
40' Memphis Depay comes off the pitch to be replaced by Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid).

38' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle and Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
35' A lofted cross from Diego Rico (Getafe) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
33' Atl. Madrid are ruled offside.
32' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) tries to find Antoine Griezmann, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
29' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

28' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, David Soria makes a great save to stop his effort. Atl. Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner.

26' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
21' Koke (Atl. Madrid) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Marcos Llorente. The ball is out of play. Getafe will take a throw-in.
19' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.

18' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.
15' Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
15' The linesman raises his flag. Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged offside.
14' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle and it's Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
11' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
10' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar!
7' Getafe failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
6' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul after Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
3' A cross into the box finds the head of Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) who steers it goalwards, but Jan Oblak manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Getafe will take the kick-off.
